name: Grafton County, NH
findings: Grafton County has 406 nonprofit organizations. 134 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 112 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Grafton County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 13 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.
